protocol.confirmationQuestionVerbatim: Sobre la última ronda de Inicio y paso 1 (Persona 1: «Es una aplicacion que te ayuda a preparar una carpeta…» y Persona 2: «Es una aplicacion que le dice a la IA…»): ¿confirmas que eran dos personas nuevas, sin exposición previa, que vieron Inicio y después el paso 1 sin explicación, y que registraste sus palabras literales?
protocol.note: The maintainer confirmed the procedure and literal answers for Inicio and paso 1, not the specific-control procedure of the old export screen. Question strings below remain protocol prompts; exact question wording, interview date and timing of doubts were not separately confirmed. The same six answers were submitted twice; recorded once, not as four readers. No additional two-person Home/step-one round is requested for the management-only changes.

responses.question: ¿Qué crees que hace este botón?

assessment.stepOne: Both responses identify name, folder and intended work; favorable content evidence with procedure and literal answers now confirmed.
assessment.home: Responses relate project/folder preparation to AI. Reader 1 still says with AI and better responses; reader 2 does not mention a folder. Do not infer understanding of existing external AI, or measured improved answer quality. These are reader interpretations, not new product claims.
assessment.export: Not demonstrated: reader 1 cannot identify the target action and describes overload; reader 2 infers finding a file, not reviewable text to paste elsewhere. Specific-control protocol still unconfirmed, so this is not a proven failure of the button name alone.
assessment.conclusion: The two-reader Home/step-one observation is now real, protocol-confirmed evidence for the final copy, not a simulated session. Preserve the favorable step-one content and the precise limits of the Home interpretations, without claiming unanimous detailed comprehension or measured AI quality. Home and wizard source/catalog blobs are unchanged since 7717195. The earlier passing round retains its original scope.
